children: US electrical systems installer Q4 revenue grew 55% yr/yr, driven by strong execution and market demand
Adjusted EPS for Q4 more than doubled yr/yr, reflecting improved margins and project execution
Company completed DBM Global acquisition and expanded share repurchase program by $350 mln
Company expects continued strong organic growth in fiscal 2027 in key business segments
IES Holdings anticipates new business opportunities from DBM Global acquisition in fiscal 2027
Company expects strong operating cash flow in fiscal 2027 to repay debt and fund growth
DATA CENTER DEMAND - Co said revenue growth in Communications, Commercial & Industrial, and Infrastructure Solutions segments was driven by strong demand and execution in the data center end market
FAVORABLE PROJECT MIX - Operating margins benefited from large, quick-turning projects in Commercial & Industrial segment executed at favorable margins
RESIDENTIAL WEAKNESS - Residential segment revenue declined due to weak housing demand, higher mortgage rates, and cost pressures, partly offset by expansion into new markets
Q4 Net Income Attributable To Shareholders
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for IES Holdings Inc is $440.00, about 163.6% above its November 19 closing price of $166.90
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 34 three months ago
